new_head = '''"""SyncWise computational module; exact fabric calendar + sampled circuits.

The legacy stochastic topology generators are retained after the exact part.
"""
from array import array

from utils import declared_period, phase_tables, ceil_div, AS_PER_NS

# Age field of a packed lexicographic (bound, age) key.  An optimal lineage is
# simple, so its age is < 16*(V-1) < 2**24 for V <= 262144.
AGE_SHIFT = 24
AGE_MULT = 1 << AGE_SHIFT
AGE_MASK = AGE_MULT - 1


class Fabric:
    """Everything the compiler, the auditor and the replay engine share."""

    def __init__(self, fb, cal):
        self.cal = cal
        self.N = N = int(fb['n'])
        self.T = T = int(fb['interval_ns'])
        self.S = S = int(fb['slice_ns'])
        self.O = O = int(fb['offset_ns'])
        self.reconfig = int(fb['reconfig_ns'])
        self.guards = [int(x) for x in fb['guards_ns']]
        drift = [int(x) for x in fb['drift_ppb']]
        slices = fb['slices']
        self.Q = Q = len(slices)
        self.P = P = declared_period(T, S, Q)
        self.V = V = P * N
        self.SHIFT = max(1, V.bit_length())
        self.VMASK = (1 << self.SHIFT) - 1
        sl, rho = phase_tables(T, S, O, P, Q)
        self.slice_of = sl
        self.rho = rho

        # ---- effective residual rates (base drift + heat), phase periodic
        hd = [[0] * (P + 1) for _ in range(N)]
        for rec in fb['heat']:
            node = int(rec[0])
            a = int(rec[1])
            b = int(rec[2])
            x = int(rec[3])
            hd[node][a] += x
            hd[node][b] -= x
        self.effn = effn = []
        for i in range(N):
            row = [0] * P
            acc = drift[i]
            d = hd[i]
            for p in range(P):
                acc += d[p]
                row[p] = acc
            effn.append(row)
        hd = None

        # ---- anchors
        ad = [[0] * (P + 1) for _ in range(N)]
        for rec in fb['anchors']:
            node = int(rec[0])
            ad[node][int(rec[1])] += 1
            ad[node][int(rec[2])] -= 1
        self.anchor_nodes = anchor_nodes = [[] for _ in range(P)]
        self.is_anchor = is_anchor = bytearray(V)
        for i in range(N):
            acc = 0
            d = ad[i]
            for p in range(P):
                acc += d[p]
                if acc:
                    anchor_nodes[p].append(i)
                    is_anchor[p * N + i] = 1
        ad = None
        self.anchor_verts = [p * N + i for p in range(P) for i in anchor_nodes[p]]

        # ---- local waiting: cost / packed key per vertex
        wcost = [0] * V
        for p in range(P):
            base = p * N
            t = T
            for i in range(N):
                wcost[base + i] = effn[i][p] * t
        self.wcost = wcost
        self.wkey = [(wcost[v] << AGE_SHIFT) | 1 for v in range(V)]
        self.allowcol = [wcost[p * N:(p + 1) * N] for p in range(P)]

        # ---- prefix sums of the waiting costs, extended past one period
        ext = P + 18
        self.mp = mp = [t % P for t in range(ext)]
        pc = []
        for i in range(N):
            e = effn[i]
            row = [0] * ext
            acc = 0
            for t in range(ext - 1):
                acc += e[mp[t]] * T
                row[t + 1] = acc
            pc.append(row)
        self.pc = pc

        # ---- blackouts as phase bitmasks per link
        links = fb['links']
        self.L = L = len(links)
        bmask = [0] * L
        for rec in fb['blackouts']:
            l = int(rec[0])
            a = int(rec[1])
            b = int(rec[2])
            bmask[l] |= ((1 << (b - a)) - 1) << a
        self.bmask = bmask

        # ---- window masks: phases touched by a flight of k intervals
        wmask = []
        full = (1 << P) - 1
        for p in range(P):
            row = [0] * 9
            for k in range(1, 9):
                if k >= P:
                    row[k] = full
                else:
                    m = 0
                    for j in range(k):
                        m |= 1 << mp[p + j]
                    row[k] = m
            wmask.append(row)
        self.wmask = wmask

        # ---- per link / direction tables
        n0 = [0] * L; n1 = [0] * L
        s0 = [0] * L; s1 = [0] * L
        g0 = [0] * L; g1 = [0] * L
        dl0 = [0] * L; dl1 = [0] * L
        q0 = [0] * L; q1 = [0] * L
        k0 = [0] * L; k1 = [0] * L
        pt0 = [0] * L; pt1 = [0] * L
        Hc = [0] * (2 * L)
        Cc = [0] * (2 * L)
        H = cal.H
        CO = cal.corr
        for l in range(L):
            lk = links[l]
            ends = lk['ends']
            e0 = ends[0]; e1 = ends[1]
            n0[l] = int(e0[0]); s0[l] = int(e0[1]); g0[l] = int(e0[2])
            n1[l] = int(e1[0]); s1[l] = int(e1[1]); g1[l] = int(e1[2])
            dn = lk['delay_ns']; dq = lk['defer_rounds']
            dl0[l] = int(dn[0]); dl1[l] = int(dn[1])
            q0[l] = int(dq[0]); q1[l] = int(dq[1])
            k0[l] = ceil_div(dl0[l], T); k1[l] = ceil_div(dl1[l], T)
            pt0[l] = k0[l] * T - dl0[l]; pt1[l] = k1[l] * T - dl1[l]
            Hc[2 * l] = H[g0[l]][g1[l]]; Hc[2 * l + 1] = H[g1[l]][g0[l]]
            Cc[2 * l] = CO[g0[l]][g1[l]]; Cc[2 * l + 1] = CO[g1[l]][g0[l]]
        self.n0 = n0; self.n1 = n1; self.s0 = s0; self.s1 = s1
        self.g0 = g0; self.g1 = g1
        self.dl0 = dl0; self.dl1 = dl1
        self.q0 = q0; self.q1 = q1
        self.k0 = k0; self.k1 = k1
        self.pt0 = pt0; self.pt1 = pt1
        self.Hc = Hc; self.Cc = Cc
        # dirinfo[code] = (src, dst, slot_src, delay, k, defer, group_src, group_dst)
        di = [None] * (2 * L)
        for l in range(L):
            di[2 * l] = (n0[l], n1[l], s0[l], dl0[l], k0[l], q0[l], g0[l], g1[l])
            di[2 * l + 1] = (n1[l], n0[l], s1[l], dl1[l], k1[l], q1[l], g1[l], g0[l])
        self.dirinfo = di

        # ---- slices actually sampled by some phase
        used = set(sl)
        self.slice_sets = {}
        for s in used:
            self.slice_sets[s] = set(int(x) for x in slices[s])
        self.slices = slices

        # ---- sampled directed steps, CSR by source vertex
        self._build_steps()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ steps
    def aging(self, node, p, k, q, delay):
        """Receiver ageing allowance (as) between physical reception and
        application of a message sent at phase p."""
        kk = p + k
        mp = self.mp
        res = self.effn[node][mp[kk - 1]] * (kk * self.T - delay)
        if q:
            res += self.pc[node][kk + q] - self.pc[node][kk]
        return res

    def step_info(self, code, p, g):
        """(dst_vertex, cost, age_delta) of an eligible step, else None."""
        if code < 0 or code >= 2 * self.L:
            return None
        l = code >> 1
        n0 = self.n0; n1 = self.n1
        if (code & 1) == 0:
            src = n0[l]; dst = n1[l]; delay = self.dl0[l]; q = self.q0[l]; k = self.k0[l]
        else:
            src = n1[l]; dst = n0[l]; delay = self.dl1[l]; q = self.q1[l]; k = self.k1[l]
        sl = self.slice_of[p]
        ss = self.slice_sets.get(sl)
        if ss is None or l not in ss:
            return None
        rp = self.rho[p]
        if rp < g or rp + delay + g > self.S:
            return None
        bm = self.bmask[l]
        if bm and (bm & self.wmask[p][k]):
            return None
        cost = self.Hc[code] + self.aging(dst, p, k, q, delay)
        return ((p + k + q) % self.P) * self.N + dst, cost, k + q, src

    def _build_steps(self):
        N = self.N; P = self.P; V = self.V; T = self.T; S = self.S
        counts = [0] * V
        srcv = array('i')
        dstl = []
        mkeyl = []
        gmaxl = array('i')
        kindl = array('i')
        slice_of = self.slice_of; rho = self.rho; slices = self.slices
        slice_sets = self.slice_sets
        bmask = self.bmask; wmask = self.wmask
        n0 = self.n0; n1 = self.n1
        dl0 = self.dl0; dl1 = self.d1 if False else self.dl1
        q0 = self.q0; q1 = self.q1; k0 = self.k0; k1 = self.k1
        pt0 = self.pt0; pt1 = self.pt1; Hc = self.Hc
        effn = self.effn; pc = self.pc; mp = self.mp
        app = srcv.append
        appd = dstl.append
        appm = mkeyl.append
        appg = gmaxl.append
        appk = kindl.append
        for p in range(P):
            sl = slice_of[p]
            ss = slice_sets.get(sl)
            if not ss:
                continue
            rp = rho[p]
            wmp = wmask[p]
            pN = p * N
            for l in slices[sl]:
                bm = bmask[l]
                # direction end0 -> end1
                d = dl0[l]
                gm = rp if rp < S - rp - d else S - rp - d
                if gm >= 0 and (bm == 0 or not (bm & wmp[k0[l]])):
                    k = k0[l]; q = q0[l]; dn = n1[l]
                    kk = p + k
                    ag = effn[dn][mp[kk - 1]] * pt0[l]
                    if q:
                        ag += pc[dn][kk + q] - pc[dn][kk]
                    counts[pN + n0[l]] += 1
                    app(pN + n0[l])
                    appd(((kk + q) % P) * N + dn)
                    appm(((Hc[2 * l] + ag) << AGE_SHIFT) | (k + q))
                    appg(gm)
                    appk(2 * l)
                # direction end1 -> end0
                d = dl1[l]
                gm = rp if rp < S - rp - d else S - rp - d
                if gm >= 0 and (bm == 0 or not (bm & wmp[k1[l]])):
                    k = k1[l]; q = q1[l]; dn = n0[l]
                    kk = p + k
                    ag = effn[dn][mp[kk - 1]] * pt1[l]
                    if q:
                        ag += pc[dn][kk + q] - pc[dn][kk]
                    counts[pN + n1[l]] += 1
                    app(pN + n1[l])
                    appd(((kk + q) % P) * N + dn)
                    appm(((Hc[2 * l + 1] + ag) << AGE_SHIFT) | (k + q))
                    appg(gm)
                    appk(2 * l + 1)
        E = len(dstl)
        indptr = [0] * (V + 1)
        acc = 0
        for v in range(V):
            indptr[v] = acc
            acc += counts[v]
        indptr[V] = acc
        edst = [0] * E
        mkey = [0] * E
        egmax = array('i', bytes(4 * E))
        ekind = array('i', bytes(4 * E))
        pos = indptr[:V]
        for e in range(E):
            s = srcv[e]
            t = pos[s]
            pos[s] = t + 1
            edst[t] = dstl[e]
            mkey[t] = mkeyl[e]
            egmax[t] = gmaxl[e]
            ekind[t] = kindl[e]
        self.indptr = indptr
        self.edst = edst
        self.mkey = mkey
        self.egmax = egmax
        self.ekind = ekind
        self.E = E

    def guard_gmax_profile(self):
        """sorted gmax values, used to skip guards with identical circuits."""
        return self.egmax


# ------------------------------------------------------- legacy stochastic API
'''
open('topo.py','w').write(new_head + legacy)
